chapter: Bay St. Louis roots and early music
title: Opening: date, place, names and birth of Sumner Labat
summary: Allen records the date and place, Labat and wife Carmen give names, and Labat gives his birth (1894) and says his father played baritone in the Promo brass band.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace
